text: Selecting a desk never holds inventory. Inventory is reserved only on authorized payment confirmation and atomic allocation.
Only admins approve online payment proofs. Staff may confirm authorized kiosk counter payments.
Closing the assistant clears its in-memory conversation. Reopening starts an empty session.
READY uploads are not searchable. An authorized admin must review and explicitly Publish.
Failed replacement leaves the old published version active.
Staff may access currently authorized shared excerpts; original files remain admin-only.
Synthetic UI glossary: Dashboard is a navigation label, and Settings is another label.
Synthetic export example: CSV columns may contain quoted commas and escaped quotation marks.
Synthetic map glossary: A floor contains named workspace instances and structural map elements.
Synthetic date example: October 1 follows September 30 in the Gregorian calendar.
Synthetic color glossary: Red, green, and blue are color words, not authorization rules.
Synthetic timezone example: Asia/Manila is an IANA timezone name.
Synthetic identity glossary: A UUID is an identifier, not a permission grant.
Synthetic table glossary: A column header labels the values in its column.
Synthetic browser glossary: A tab and a window describe different browser surfaces.
Synthetic file glossary: PDF, DOCX, DOC, and MD are document formats.
Synthetic job glossary: A checkpoint records completed processing progress.
Synthetic encoder glossary: Normalization rescales a vector to unit length.
Synthetic payment glossary: A QR image can encode a token or another payload.
Synthetic review glossary: A preview lets an operator inspect extracted text.
Synthetic status glossary: A title is metadata attached to a document.
Synthetic model glossary: A revision identifies a specific model artifact.
Synthetic occupancy glossary: An interval has a start and an end.
Synthetic worker glossary: A heartbeat reports that a process remains active.
